query:
What did the family appear to agree on regarding planning for Loretta's care, and what did Marcus's response in that exchange actually reveal about whether the agreement was complete?

Options:
A. Tanya
B. Kevin
C. Loretta
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Loretta, episodic, t14 @2026-03-01T16:22:00) Good. That is settled then. Now. How is everyone?
[2] (about=Diane, episodic, t14 @2026-03-01T16:42:00) Agreed. Re: April 11, I've sent Marcus the logistics draft. Kevin, have you confirmed flights? And Mama, is the guest room still set up from February or does it need resetting? Just so I know what to plan for.
[3] (about=Diane, core, t6 @2026-02-01T17:24:00) Acknowledges she can be a lot about Loretta's health; says she's working on it.
[4] (about=Diane, core, t3 @2026-01-25T14:30:00) Proposes weekend of February 14th for visit to Loretta in Durham; can drive from Atlanta Friday evening, stay through Sunday.
[5] (about=Kevin, core, t0 @2026-01-11T16:02:00) Wishes Loretta good luck and will pray.
[6] (about=Kevin, core, t2 @2026-01-18T15:47:00) Kevin is writing down the Chestnut family information and wants to use Loretta's quote in his presentation notes with her name.
[7] (about=Loretta, core, t8 @2026-02-08T15:22:00) Loretta asserts it is her kitchen and she was supervising.
[8] (about=Loretta, said_by=Tanya, profile, t8 @2026-02-08T15:22:00) Tanya says Loretta tried to sneak back into the kitchen during cleanup.
[9] (about=Marcus, core, t10 @2026-02-15T16:47:00) Went up to Loretta's house Tuesday night after she called about missing BP meds; stayed through Wednesday; reorganized kitchen and labeled cabinets.
[10] (about=Marcus, said_by=Diane, profile, t10 @2026-02-15T16:47:00) Diane notes that Marcus's view has been that Loretta manages fine, but Tuesday was a different kind of moment.
[11] (about=Tanya, core, t10 @2026-02-15T16:47:00) Wants to check in with Loretta about medication storage setup; notes that Loretta calling at 11pm indicates anxiety, not just disorganization.
[12] (about=Tanya, core, t6 @2026-02-01T17:24:00) Loretta's BP log has been consistent; numbers better than three months before ER visit.
agent_answer:
Based on the material, the family appeared to agree on the practical logistics of an April 11 visit/plan for Loretta’s care: Diane had sent Marcus a logistics draft, Kevin was to confirm flights, and the guest room needed to be checked or set up.

Marcus’s response—or more precisely Diane’s observation about him—revealed that the agreement was not fully complete/settled: Marcus had previously held that Loretta manages fine, but the Tuesday night episode (her call about missing BP meds) was “a different kind of moment.” That suggests he was not entirely on board before the incident, and his shift in view was still part of an incomplete, evolving agreement.

So the person whose response revealed the incomplete agreement is **D. Marcus**.
